name: naeel-zuriek-site
//: Deployed by git pull + npm install on cPanel. cPanel's Node Selector runs npm install with NODE_ENV=production, which OMITS devDependencies — so every package `next build` needs (Tailwind/PostCSS, TypeScript, @types/*) is kept in `dependencies` on purpose. ESLint stays a dev tool; next.config.ts sets eslint.ignoreDuringBuilds so the server build does not need it.
